questions.q: Which describes the rule of thirds?
options: Place the subject in the exact centre
Divide the frame into a 3×3 grid and place the subject on the lines
questions.why: The rule of thirds uses a 3×3 grid to place the focal point.

questions.q: Photographs taken by the student are:
questions.why: Your own photographs are first-hand sources, which support AO1.

questions.q: What does a wide aperture (e.g. f/2) mainly give?
options: A blurred background (shallow depth of field)
questions.why: A wide aperture gives shallow depth of field.

questions.q: Why must a painted piece still be photographed or scanned?
questions.model: All work is submitted as a digital portfolio online, and the examiner can only mark what they can clearly see.
